title.narrative: Lifesaving Cash Interventions for Vulnerable Households' Food Security and Early Recovery in Dinsoor

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed intervention by HIRDA (Himilo Relief and Development Association), funded by the Somalia Humanitarian Fund (SHF), aims to deliver integrated life-saving food assistance to highly vulnerable and underserved communities in Dinsoor district, Bay region of South West State, Somalia. The target population, currently in IPC Phases 3 and 4, faces critical food insecurity exacerbated by conflict, drought, displacement, and limited humanitarian access.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtDinsoor has been under the control of non-state actors for over seven years, with extreme insecurity and poor road infrastructure making it a red zone for humanitarian operations. The district has experienced repeated crop failures, market access restrictions, and large-scale displacement, leading to heightened vulnerability and eroded resilience. Thousands of households lack food, income, and access to essential services.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe intervention responds directly to SHF’s strategic objective to reach hard-to-access, underserved rural areas with timely, life-saving support. It includes two core components, supplemented with protection mainstreaming, community engagement, and accountability mechanisms.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt1. Provision of Unconditional Cash Transfers (UCT):ltbrgtHIRDA will support 1,091 vulnerable households—primarily IDPs, female-headed households, families with malnourished children, persons with disabilities, and poor host communities—through monthly unconditional cash assistance of $55 per household over three months. Transfers will be delivered through Hormuud’s EVC Plus mobile money platform, widely used in Dinsoor. This flexible modality supports local market recovery, allows beneficiary choice, and preserves dignity. Beneficiaries will be identified using a vulnerability-based targeting approach and registered using the standardized Single Registration Form. A referral mechanism will also be established to link households to additional sector-specific support where needed.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt2. Provision of Emergency Conditional Cash Transfers (CCT) through Cash-for-Work (CfW):ltbrgtTo strengthen community resilience and promote early recovery, 1,091 households will receive cash assistance over two months in return for participation in labor-intensive activities focused on rehabilitating feeder roads. These roads are vital for improving access to markets, services, and humanitarian assistance. The CfW component also boosts local employment and injects income into the community. Work will be coordinated with local labor supervisors and community leaders, ensuring adherence to safety protocols, equitable participation (including by women), and fair labor practices. Activities will accommodate physical capacity differences and ensure inclusive participation. Attendance will be monitored daily and verified for payment.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtImpact and Importance of the Project:ltbrgtThis intervention will have a significant impact on a chronically underserved district. UCTs empower families to meet their own needs, restore dignity, and reduce dependency, while CfW activities enhance community infrastructure and long-term food security. The dual approach offers both immediate humanitarian relief and early recovery, making it sustainable and impactful.ltbrgtThe project also incorporates key cross-cutting priorities:ltbrgt Gender and protection mainstreaming: Distribution points will be safe and accessible for women and girls. Special attention will be given to female-headed households and marginalized groups.ltbrgt Community participation and accountability: Relief committees will be involved in targeting, complaint handling, and monitoring. Community feedback mechanisms will be used throughout the project cycle.ltbrgt Operational readiness and access: HIRDA will rely on its existing presence, use local staff familiar with the context, and coordinate with local authorities to navigate access and security risks. Pre-positioning and use of mobile money will enhance speed and efficiency.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
